description: Source code for an OpenGL renderer class implementing GLSurfaceView.Renderer, responsible for rendering 2D shapes and managing OpenGL ES drawing lifecycle.

classes.name: MyGLRenderer
classes.description: Implements GLSurfaceView.Renderer to handle OpenGL rendering, including setting up the scene, drawing frames, and handling surface changes.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL settings and creates shape objects.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Clears buffers, sets camera view, applies transformations, and draws shapes each frame.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts viewport and projection matrix when surface dimensions change.

methods.name: getAngle
methods.description: Returns the current rotation angle of the triangle.

methods.name: setAngle
methods.description: Sets the rotation angle of the triangle.
